claims.exact_statement: For every Boolean P and d>=1, the parity-balanced fair half-activation tower T_d(P) satisfies the exact G recurrence in PROOF.md and G(T_d(P))<=2^-d G(P)+K_*, K_*=15/4-(27/16)log2(4/3). Hence GU'(a,b) for P, with a>=0 and 0<=b<1, implies GU'(a+K_*,b) for T_d(P).
hypotheses: fresh independent fair selector at every level
fresh independent parity character before every activation
claims.status_detail: The proof is self-contained; earlier activation work and B19 review are used for comparison and scope only.
claims.first_unproved_line: No perturbed scalar recurrence is proved for imperfect balancing, biased selectors, or shared variables.
